sentences.en: The playwright cherishes the vivid memories of his childhood.
sentences.zh: 这位剧作家珍藏着童年的生动记忆。

sentences.en: I'm still haunted by a vivid nightmare I had last night.
sentences.zh: 我仍然被昨晚做的一个栩栩如生的噩梦困扰。

sentences.en: I am pleased with this vivid portrait in particular.
sentences.zh: 我对这幅生动的肖像尤其满意。

senses.zh: 生动的,（记忆、描述等）清晰的,（人的想像）丰富的,（光、颜色等）鲜艳的，耀眼的
